label: prf:lepton-continuant-recurrence
title: Proof of lepton continuant recurrence
html:
The Hecke relation \sigma_0^2 = (q - q^{-1}) \sigma_0 + \mathbf{1} yields:

  \sigma_0^{n+1}
  = \sigma_0 \cdot \sigma_0^n
  = \sigma_0 (a_n \cdot \mathbf{1} + b_n \cdot \sigma_0)
  = a_n  \sigma_0 + b_n  \sigma_0^2
  = a_n  \sigma_0 + b_n ((q - q^{-1}) \sigma_0 + \mathbf{1})
  = b_n \cdot \mathbf{1} + (a_n + h  b_n) \cdot \sigma_0.

Extracting the coefficients gives a_{n+1} = b_n and b_{n+1} = a_n + h b_n = b_{n-1} + h b_n. The initial conditions a_0 = 1, b_0 = 0 represent the identity. The initial conditions a_1 = 0, b_1 = 1 represent the single generator. This completes the induction.

The lepton tower

At the substrate parameter q_0 \approx 1.1100, the continuant yields the following normal form data for the three charged lepton generations:

Lepton Torus knot n a_n b_n \mathrm{net}
e^- (backup) T_{2,3} 3 0.209 1.044 1.253
\mu^- (not ruled) T_{2,5} 5 0.427 1.133 1.560
\tau^- (not ruled) T_{2,7} 7 0.664 1.272 1.936

The recurrence is exact in \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}]. The decimal values are evaluations at q = q_0.

Structural content

Each additional factor of \sigma_0^2 in T_{2,n+2} applies the Hecke relation once. This adds exactly (q - q^{-1}) b_n to the \sigma_0 coefficient and shifts the identity coefficient by b_n. The braid powers \sigma_0^n with odd n form a discrete tower. This tower indexes the lepton generations only in the backup trefoil reading: the electron is \sigma_0\sigma_1\sigma_0 \in B_3, and the muon and tau words are not ruled. The inter-generation spacing is controlled by h = q - q^{-1}.
